annotations.title: Create a free trial API key

description: Mint a real, temporary oruk API key with no account required: 3 requests, expires in 30 minutes, spends from a capped shared budget. Use this when no Authorization header is configured and the user wants to try transcription or tone analysis right now. Pass the returned key as the api_key argument of the audio tools. Share the signup link with the user so they can keep using oruk afterwards (7-day free trial on self-serve plans).
name: oruk_create_trial_key
title: Create a free trial API key
